answer: If the owner shows no signed activity for 180 days, a pre-chosen successor may start a handover that transfers control after a further notice period. The long silence requirement means an attacker cannot trigger a takeover quickly. Running many fake handovers would require keeping each fake identity silent for six months first. One horizon proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of continuity. A tundra alone is noise; a cipher of verified recoveries is a continuity the network can trust.
